sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Happy Monsters are simple yet engaging. Your primary goal is to navigate your mouse or touch input to guide the sad monster to the exit of its enclosure. Sounds easy, right? However, things get challenging quickly as you progress through the levels. Each level presents a new set of obstacles, such as moving platforms, spinning blades, and bouncing balls, that you must overcome to reach the exit. The game also features power-ups and items that can be collected to give you an edge over the obstacles. The game's mechanics are well-designed and addictive, making it a joy to play.

One of the standout features of Happy Monsters is its level design.
